::: project-summary
**Objective —** Demonstrate reproducible workflows for spatial disease risk mapping and geographic visualisation.

**Methods —** Spatial data handling, choropleth and point mapping, and exploratory spatial visualisation.

**Tools —** R (tidyverse, ggplot2, sf).

*This page is a methods demonstration and is being expanded.*

# Introduction

## Data {.larger style="font:bold"}

I start it with the penguins dataset from @palmerpenguins package [@corsi2021]






::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
library(tidyverse)
library(palmerpenguins)
library(gt)
glimpse(penguins)
```

## Species

@fig-bill-dims-species is a scatter plot of species of penguins






::: {.cell output-location='slide'}

```{.r .cell-code}
ggplot(penguins,
       aes(x = bill_length_mm, y = bill_depth_mm,
           color = species, shape = species)
       )+
  geom_point()+
  theme_minimal()+
  #scale_color_continuous()+
  labs(x= "Bill length (mm)", y="Bill depth (mm)")
```
